notes: 'seeing that' is a rule 7 helper on the participle, which is the token carrying the subordination (rule 86), and 'off' is the preverb's realization inside the same unit (rule 106).
ἀλλήλους heads on 'another', the word realizing the ἄλλος lexeme, discontinuously round the preposition (rules 15, 83).
ταῖς is emptied by the possessive 'his', which αὐτοῦ licenses (rule 20).
